note: State Bank of India's Savings Bank Account page (rendered, read 29 October 2026): the account asks no monthly average balance, so carries no charge for falling below one; cheque books beyond the first ten leaves a year and free withdrawals limited by the balance aren't modelled. Read 2026-10-30: the savings bank deposit pays 2.50% a year from 15 June 2025 (the figure in the deposit-rates page's quick links, its fourth tab, SB Account, read from the page's markup); at other banks' ATMs in India a savings account has five free transactions a month, then 23 rupees plus GST a withdrawal from 1 December 2025 (written as free; the form holds one figure). Not stated in what was read: SBI's own ATMs (free withdrawals are tied to the monthly average balance), overdraft, a returned payment, transfers (NEFT and IMPS are priced in separate notices not read), the card's share abroad, what opening asks.
